## File: facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/examples/pointer_generator/pointer_generator_src/transformer_pg.py

Prompts

```
['build a transformer pointer generator model instance with encoder and decoder using build_model', 'configure the number of attention heads and layer index used for pointing in the decoder', 'run the transformer pointer generator encoder forward pass to get encoder outputs with source tokens', 'run the decoder output layer to mix generation probabilities with attention distributions for pointer generation', 'create an embedding layer that maps out-of-vocabulary token indices to the unknown token embedding']
```

```
{'build_transformer_pointer_generator_model': 'build a transformer pointer generator model instance with encoder and decoder using build_model', 'configure_alignment_heads_and_layer': 'configure the number of attention heads and layer index used for pointing in the decoder', 'run_encoder_forward_pass': 'run the transformer pointer generator encoder forward pass to get encoder outputs with source tokens', 'run_decoder_output_layer': 'run the decoder output layer to mix generation probabilities with attention distributions for pointer generation', 'create_embedding_with_oov_mapping': 'create an embedding layer that maps out-of-vocabulary token indices to the unknown token embedding'}
```
